outputs.explanation: Spatial plots show per-spot deconvolution scores overlaid on tissue as a heatmap-style visualization (each dot already represents an individual spot value); heatmap/spatial feature plots are exempt from requiring additional individual point overlay.
Box plots are exempt as they already show data distribution, and here individual data points (dots for each biological replicate/spot) are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
These are GSEA enrichment (line) plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.

This is a bar chart showing log2 fold-change values (a summary statistic derived from many biological replicates/spots) for each gene, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars to show the underlying spread of values.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
